contract: GET /api/stats/year/:year is admin-only (StatsController.middleware). The year is parsed with Number() and 400 is returned unless it is between 2000 and 9999; otherwise the year report is returned with the counts, sizes, durations, listening sessions, cover ids and the top author, narrator and genre lists.
exceptions: Historical verification claims are retained only in the archived pre-2026-11-13 record; they do not establish current named-test coverage or invariant verification.
State scenarios are not applicable: this capability is a stateless request/middleware/static-serving contract.

Mapping only: no tests executed in this invocation. Historical evidence is retained for provenance and does not verify this checkout; named tests are assertion leads, not exhaustive proof of every stated requirement.

invariants.contract: The route answers 401 without a token, 403 to a non-admin before the year is parsed (also for an invalid year), and 400 for a year that is not a number or is below 2000 or above 9999; 2000 and 9999 are accepted.
exceptions: Named tests listed are relevant package-level current tests; their assertions do not yet prove every route branch or the complete upstream contract.

invariants.contract: The payload has exactly numListeningSessions, numBooksAdded, numAuthorsAdded, totalBooksAddedSize, totalBooksAddedDuration, booksAddedWithCovers, totalBooksSize, totalBooksDuration, totalListeningTime, numBooks, topAuthors, topNarrators and topGenres. For 2026 the fixture yields 7 sessions, 5 books, 3 authors, 670358 bytes added, 138 rounded seconds, the two item ids that have a cover, 65.4 seconds listened and the top lists Terry Fixture 49, Nora Narrator 9, Technology 17 and Fiction 12. totalBooksSize, totalBooksDuration and numBooks are the whole library for every year because the source year filter compares against the literal ":nextYear-01-01", which every stored date sorts before; a year without items returns zeros and empty lists.
